title: Add DoseLogDao
description: Room DAO for the dose_logs table: recent doses for a profile, the most recent dose of a specific medication for a profile (drives the live 'next eligible' UI, plus a suspend snapshot variant for headless callers), all doses with a still-pending reminder (for reboot re-arm), and a plain insert with no compare-and-set guard since every dose log is an additive history event, not a mutable flag.
acceptance_criteria: observeRecentForProfile(profileId: Int, limit: Int = 50): Flow<List<DoseLog>> ordered by givenAtEpochMillis DESC
observeMostRecentDose(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int): Flow<DoseLog?> filtering on both profileId and medicationId, ordered by givenAtEpochMillis DESC LIMIT 1
suspend fun getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int): DoseLog? with the same filter/order as observeMostRecentDose, for non-UI callers
suspend fun getPendingReminders(nowEpochMillis: Long): List<DoseLog> selecting rows where nextEligibleAtEpochMillis IS NOT NULL AND nextEligibleAtEpochMillis > :nowEpochMillis
suspend fun insert(doseLog: DoseLog): Long annotated @Insert, with no WHERE-guarded update -- this is a plain insert, not a compare-and-set
Valid Kotlin under package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data referencing the DoseLog entity from the same package
